title.en: SF Bay Chinese community services: Chinatown, seniors, and legal help
title.zh: 灣區華人社區服務：華埠、長者與法律協助

excerpt.en: ChineseSFBay needs source-linked service coverage from real Bay Area organizations, not empty feeds or generic California copy.
excerpt.zh: ChineseSFBay 需要連到真實灣區機構的服務內容，而不是空文章列表或泛加州文字。

body.en: A useful Bay Area Chinese article feed should surface organizations readers can actually use. Chinese for Affirmative Action, Self-Help for the Elderly, Chinese Hospital, and API Legal Outreach each answer a different resident need: civic rights, senior services, health navigation, and legal help.
body.zh: 有用的灣區華人文章列表應呈現讀者真的會用到的機構。華促會、安老自助處、東華醫院與 API Legal Outreach 分別對應不同居民需求：公民權益、長者服務、健康導航與法律協助。

body.en: That mix matters because the Bay Area is not one city. A reader may live in San Francisco, work on the Peninsula, help family in Oakland, and look for services in Cantonese, Mandarin, or English.
body.zh: 這種組合很重要，因為灣區不是單一城市。讀者可能住在舊金山、在半島工作、協助奧克蘭家人，並需要粵語、華語或英文服務。

body.en: This baseline item gives the SF Bay archive a real community-service spine while runtime Radar can add fresher headlines later.
body.zh: 這篇基礎內容讓灣區文章庫先有真實的社區服務骨架，之後即時 Radar 仍可加入更新新聞。

title.en: South Bay civic watch for immigrant families and students
title.zh: 面向移民家庭與學生的南灣市政觀察

excerpt.en: San Jose and Santa Clara County coverage should connect civic reporting with practical immigrant-resource sources.
excerpt.zh: 聖荷西與聖塔克拉拉縣內容應把市政報導與實用移民資源來源連起來。

body.en: San Jose Spotlight gives ChineseSFBay a local reporting source for South Bay civic decisions, development, business issues, and neighborhood policy debates. That is more useful for South Bay readers than a generic San Francisco-only feed.
body.zh: San Jose Spotlight 為 ChineseSFBay 提供南灣市政決策、開發、商業議題與社區政策討論的本地報導來源。這比只有舊金山泛用內容更適合南灣讀者。

body.en: Asian Law Alliance adds the practical side for immigrant families: legal navigation, public benefits, housing, and community advocacy. A source-linked brief can tell readers why an issue matters while preserving the original source path.
body.zh: Asian Law Alliance 則補上移民家庭的實用面：法律導航、公共福利、住房與社區倡議。有來源連結的摘要可以說明議題為何重要，同時保留原始來源路徑。

body.en: For students and families moving between San Jose, Santa Clara, Cupertino, Sunnyvale, and Fremont, this is the type of article selection that feels local rather than scraped.
body.zh: 對往返 San Jose、Santa Clara、Cupertino、Sunnyvale 與 Fremont 的學生和家庭來說，這類文章選擇才會顯得本地化，而不是抓取拼湊。

title.en: East Bay dining openings and Chinatown corridor watch
title.zh: 東灣餐飲新店與華埠走廊觀察

excerpt.en: Oakland and Berkeley dining coverage gives the Bay Area feed a real East Bay lane instead of treating San Francisco as the whole region.
excerpt.zh: 奧克蘭與柏克萊餐飲內容讓灣區文章列表擁有真正的東灣路徑，而不是把舊金山當成整個灣區。

body.en: The Oaklandside's East Bay Nosh and Eater SF's East Bay restaurant guides are stronger sources than a generic food scrape because they keep the focus on Oakland, Berkeley, Richmond, and neighborhoods east of the bridge.
body.zh: The Oaklandside 的 East Bay Nosh 與 Eater SF 的東灣餐廳指南，比泛用餐飲抓取更可靠，因為它們把焦點放在 Oakland、Berkeley、Richmond 與海灣大橋以東的街區。

body.en: ChineseSFBay should use that coverage to help readers notice openings, closures, and corridors that affect weekend plans, family meals, and small-business visibility around Oakland Chinatown and nearby communities.
body.zh: ChineseSFBay 應利用這類來源，協助讀者掌握影響週末安排、家庭聚餐與奧克蘭華埠及周邊小商家能見度的新店、結束營業與街區變化。

body.en: Runtime Radar can make this fresher later, but the static baseline keeps the Bay Area article archive from being empty when the store has not published anything yet.
body.zh: 之後即時 Radar 可讓內容更新，但靜態基礎內容能避免資料庫尚未發布文章時，灣區文章庫變成空白。

title.en: SFO, SJC, and official notices for Bay Area families
title.zh: 灣區家庭應查看的 SFO、SJC 與官方通知

excerpt.en: Airport and official updates belong in the Bay Area article mix because families often split travel between SFO, SJC, and Oakland-area routes.
excerpt.zh: 機場與官方更新應納入灣區文章組合，因為許多家庭會在 SFO、SJC 與奧克蘭周邊路線之間安排出行。

body.en: Bay Area travel planning is regional. Families may choose SFO for international routes, SJC for South Bay convenience, and local transit or rideshare depending on where relatives live.
body.zh: 灣區出行規劃本來就是區域性的。家庭可能因國際航線選擇 SFO，因南灣便利選擇 SJC，再依親友住所搭配大眾運輸或叫車。

body.en: The SFO press-release page and San Jose Mineta newsroom give readers official places to confirm construction notices, airport programs, route announcements, and traveler advisories.
body.zh: SFO 新聞發布頁與 San Jose Mineta 新聞室，是讀者核對施工通知、機場項目、航線公告與旅客提醒的官方來源。

body.en: This baseline article keeps the Bay Area feed practical: readers get the source links they need before travel, and the archive does not depend on a runtime store being populated first.
body.zh: 這篇基礎文章讓灣區資訊流保持實用：讀者在出行前能取得需要的來源連結，而文章庫不必等即時資料庫先有內容。
